digest.component_or_area: codebase structure and module size governance
propositions: 46 files in src/rebar exceed 700 LOC with 7 at 796-800, triggering hard-cap threshold at 800 LOC and exhausting per-module headroom repo-wide
pass1.py and push.py each at 800 LOC were split into separate modules (container_stage.py, push_recovery.py) to reduce individual file size below 550 LOC while maintaining clean extraction seams

The module-size CI gate was enhanced to emit a non-blocking near-cap warning for files within 10% of the 800-LOC cap (720+ LOC), surfacing the existing but latent near_cap_count metric that had been returning false zeros due to missing scc binary and adapter bugs

All three changes (near-cap CI warning, pass1.py split, push.py split) earned LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1, merged through Gerrit as changes 1751/1752/1753, and are reachable from origin/main with architecture documentation updated to record both splits and the leading indicator
